description: WHEN: you need a COMPLETE picture of a D365 object in ONE call. Returns in a single response: full structure (fields, method signatures, relation summary) AND all CoC extensions / event handlers -- equivalent to calling get_object_details THEN find_extensions. Use this INSTEAD of those two separate calls to reduce round-trips. Optionally includes best-practice violations (set includeValidation=true). Pass `methodName` to also include the full body of a specific method. Pass `aotType` to disambiguate when several AOT objects share the same name.

aotType.description: Optional: AOT type to disambiguate, e.g. 'AxTable', 'AxClass', 'AxForm'.

includeValidation.description: Include best-practice violations (default false -- adds latency for large objects).

methodName.description: Optional: specific method name to include full body for.

name: get_object_context
